scope: New engineering diagnostics. No replacement of author data or identification of unpublished author settings.

paper_conditions.fig6: Numerical FID, T2=1.5 s, SNR=35 dB; exact frontend and statistics unknown
paper_conditions.fig10: Bench, 2128.87 Hz, 5 microVpp, 100 ms window, 10 microHz steps, multiple outputs per plateau. SNR and dwell time not specified here.
paper_conditions.fig12: Separate comparison experiment specifies 40 dB. Do not transfer this or the simulation's 35 dB to Fig.10.
paper_conditions.physical_frontend: Paper page 5 names a narrow-bandpass filter before LM193; its response is unpublished.

plateau.gate: Wilson 95% upper probability that either plateau is classified incorrectly in an independent two-level record < 5%, proposed engineering gate, not author criterion
plateau.statistics: One mean per plateau per independent continuous two-level acquisition; do not count overlapping outputs as independent trials. Frames crossing a step excluded explicitly, with full window waiting retained.
plateau.noise_model: Independent Gaussian edge jitter plus actual ceil clock quantization; no claim of complete physical frontend.
plateau.overlap_validation: For jitter >=20 ns, validate mean STD against squared combined overlap weights with 20 percent tolerance at 320 records; uniform quantization approximation used only for this check.

frontend.filter_start: Zero state at start of FID, causal sosfilt on both signal and noise, never filtfilt
frontend.filter: Butterworth order N=2 bandpass (4 poles), center near 2086 Hz; widths and guards are declared assumptions, not fitted author parameters.
frontend.statistics: Evaluate latest full window at fixed scheduled end times. Keep every record; report cycle quality rather than silently deleting failures.
frontend.dynamic: Noiseless 10 Hz 2 nT modulation; report amplitude and phase at mean event time, with no retrospective delay removal.
